scenes: What did a city learn from one deadly heatwave?
In May 2010, Ahmedabad reached forty-six point eight degrees. | An estimated thirteen hundred and forty-four extra deaths followed.

In 2013, the city launched South Asia’s first heat action plan. | Forecasts feed colour-coded alerts, | departments act together, the public is warned and health staff are trained. | From 2017, it added cool roofs.
An evaluation estimated about eleven hundred and ninety deaths a year were avoided. | The model has since spread across India.
Plan before the heat. Measure what changes.
